questions.stem: The time t required to do a job varies inversely as the number of people P who work on the job (assuming all work at the same rate). It takes 16 days for 15 people to complete the job. How many days will it take for 10 people to complete the same job?
Which of the following is false about the function y = log x?

options.A: The domain is the set of all positive real numbers.
options.B: The graph of the function passes through the point (0, 1).
options.C: The range is the set of all real numbers.
options.D: The point (100, 2) is on the graph of the function.
options.E: The graph of the function passes through the point (10, 1).

explanation_steps: log is undefined at 0, so the graph does not pass through (0, 1).
Domain is x > 0, range is all reals, log10(100) = 2, log10(10) = 1.

questions.stem: In a polygon, the sum of its interior angles is twice the sum of its exterior angles. What type of polygon is it?
If the postulates P: The measure of all obtuse angles is between 90° and 180°; and Q: The measure of angle A is 100°, are accepted, then which of the following must be the conclusion?

options.A: The supplementary of angle A is an acute angle.
options.B: Angle A is an acute angle.
options.C: Angle A is an obtuse angle.
options.D: Angle A is a reflex angle.

explanation_steps: 100° is between 90° and 180°, so angle A is obtuse by the given postulates.
Supplementary of 100° is 80°, which is acute, but the direct conclusion is that A is obtuse.
